description: This PHP source file defines the JoinedDate class, a filter field used in reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterField class and provides functionality to add date-based WHERE clauses to a query builder, specifically relating to employee joining dates.

classes.name: JoinedDate
classes.description: A class representing a date filter for employee join dates in reports, capable of adding appropriate WHERE conditions to a query based on comparison operators.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds date-based constraints to the query builder depending on the selected operator (less than, greater than, between) and date values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, notably ['employee'].
